projectDescription: A privacy-first progressive web app that helps you log daily micro-wins, celebrate them with AI-powered phrases and GIFs, and track your consistency streak — all without an account or any data leaving your device.
keyFeatures: One-tap achievement logging with instant celebration modal
AI-generated personalised celebration phrases (powered by DeepSeek via Hugging Face)
Random celebratory GIFs via GIPHY integration with offline fallback
Streak dashboard showing current streak, personal record, and total achievements
Auto-tagging of achievements into categories (work, health, family, etc.)
100% local storage — no accounts, no servers, no data collection
Export and import JSON backups to safeguard your history
Daily browser notification reminders to keep the habit alive
PWA support — installable on iOS and Android, works fully offline
